title: Markdown writes "(nested table)" in place of a nested table
symptom: to_markdown (Rust, Python) and oxoffice docx convert -t md write the placeholder "(nested table)" in a cell that holds a table, so that table's text is lost, with no diagnostic
workaround: export to HTML, which keeps nested tables (Rust to_html or to_html_fragment, Python doc.to_html(), CLI convert -t html)
